text.p: These are the leading stories in the Malawi press on Monday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Two top Malawi politicians accused President Muluzi of mixing religion with politics when he charged at a Christian function that two top opposition politicians and a religious leader were planning to incite Christians to burn down mosques inthe country.
Muluzi, also a moslem said they were also spreading rumours that Moslems had launched a campaign of burning Bibles.

- Bible Society Executive Director and two presidents of opposition parties on Sunday reacted angrily to President Bakili Muluzi's remarks that they are plotting to incite Christians to burn down mosques in the country.
